seo.link_in_bio.title: Link in bio page builder | Presh.Me
seo.link_in_bio.description: Build a clean link-in-bio page with links, portfolio and contact at one address. Free in open beta.
seo.link_in_bio.h1: A link in bio page that looks like you
seo.link_in_bio.lead: Stop dumping every link into a messy list. With Presh.Me you get one address for your work, booking, shop and socials — designed as a real mini site.
landing.step2.title: Claim your link
landing.step3.title: Build the page
landing.step3.text: Profile, links and look. The preview updates right away.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.subtitle: Short answers about your Presh.Me page, link and setup.
landing.faq.a1: Presh.Me turns your link in bio into a beautiful mini website. Add links, photos, videos, text, FAQs and socials, and share it all from one address - like presh.me/yourname.
landing.faq.q2: How long does it take to set up?
landing.faq.a2: About a minute to get started. Enter your Instagram handle and Presh.Me can pull profile details for a first page. You can also start from a website or from scratch. Then make it yours with themes, fonts and blocks, and go live when you're ready.
landing.faq.a4: Yes — in open beta you can build and publish your page for free, with no ads in your bio. A Pro plan is planned for later.
landing.faq.q5: What kind of content can I add?
landing.faq.a5: Links, text, YouTube, Spotify, images, Instagram grids, quotes, resume, FAQ and social icons. You can reorder and style blocks however you like.
landing.faq.q6: Do I need to download an app?
landing.faq.a6: No. Create and manage your whole page in the browser on phone or computer. Your visitors don't install anything either - they just open your link.
landing.faq.a7: Yes. In the studio you can edit the address while it's available. Once the link is in your bio, page updates show up right away - no need to change the bio every time.
landing.faq.a8: When Umami analytics is enabled for the site, you can see pageviews, visitors and visits. Per-link click counts are not built in yet.
landing.faq.q9: Where can I share my Presh.Me link?
landing.faq.a9: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and anywhere else with room for one link in a bio or profile.
landing.faq.a10: Yes. There are no contracts. You can stop using the account whenever you want — contact us when you need help.
